_meta.indication: LUMAKRAS is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with KRAS G12C-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC, as determined by an FDA-approved test, who have received at least one prior systemic therapy.

pivotal_trials.phase: Phase 1/2 (Phase 2 portion was the pivotal analysis)
pivotal_trials.design: Global, open-label, single-arm, multicohort, dose escalation and dose expansion study in patients with advanced/metastatic solid tumors harboring a KRAS G12C mutation.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with previously-treated (≥ 1 prior systemic therapy) KRAS G12C-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC; the population consisted primarily of current or former smokers (93%), 90% received prior platinum-based chemotherapy and 91% received a prior immune checkpoint inhibitor.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint: overall response rate (ORR); secondary endpoints included duration of response (DOR).
pivotal_trials.n: Primary efficacy population n=124 (of 427 total enrolled with KRAS G12C-mutated solid tumors).
pivotal_trials.result: ORR by BICR 36% (95% CI 28, 45); median DOR 10.0 months (range 1.3+, 11.1), with 58% of responders having DOR of at least 6 months.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥10%) included diarrhea (42%), musculoskeletal pain (35%), fatigue (26%), nausea (26%), and hepatotoxicity (25%). Serious adverse reactions occurred in 50% of patients. Key identified risks were hepatotoxicity (25%; severe 3.4%) and ILD/pneumonitis (1.5%, one fatal).
target_moa: Sotorasib is an inhibitor of the RAS GTPase family that binds irreversibly to KRAS G12C, thereby locking the kinase receptor in an inactive conformation.

rems.type: There were no significant safety concerns identified during NDA review requiring risk management beyond labeling or warranting consideration for a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS).

companion_dx_detail: Two FDA-approved companion diagnostics for KRAS G12C detection were approved contemporaneously: the QIAGEN therascreen KRAS RGQ PCR Kit (tumor tissue) and the Guardant360 CDx (plasma cfDNA).

advisory_committee.vote: FDA did not refer this application to an advisory committee as no significant efficacy or safety issues were identified during the review that required external input for the proposed indication (the review section states "FDA did not refer this supplemental application to an advisory committee").

description.text: Added new indication for sotorasib in combination with panitumumab for KRAS G12C-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer after prior chemotherapy

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application adds a new indication of Lumakras, in combination with panitumumab, for the treatment of adult patients with KRAS G12C-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer as determined by an FDA approved test, who have received prior fluoropyrimidine-, oxaliplatin-, and irinotecan-based chemotherapy. This supplement also provides for updates to the U.S. Prescribing Information (USPI) Dosage and Administration sections (2.1, Patient Selection; 2.2, Recommended Dosage and Administration; 2.3, Dosage Modifications for Adverse Reactions) and to the Warning and Precautions sections (Section 5.1, Hepatotoxicity; Section 5.2, Interstitial Lung Disease [ILD]/Pneumonitis).

surrogate_endpoint.text: Durable overall response rate (ORR of 36%) and duration of response (DOR), an endpoint reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit.

citations.quote: The effect of sotorasib on durable ORR observed in the primary efficacy population from Study 20170543 demonstrates a meaningful advantage over that achievable with FDA-approved available therapies for this refractory population.
